appName: Cafe Simulator VR - Manage Your Cafe
displayName: Cafe Simulator VR - Manage Your Cafe
display_name: Cafe Simulator VR - Manage Your Cafe
display_long_description:
Experience café management like never before with Cafe Simulator VR – Manage Your Cafe, a top-down VR café simulator featuring an immersive Mixed Reality passthrough experience on Meta Quest.

Turn your real room into a virtual café using passthrough mixed reality, where your café appears right in your physical space. View everything from a top-down perspective, giving you full control over operations while staying aware of your surroundings.

☕ Top-Down Cafe Management in VR
Oversee your café from above, manage customer flow, prepare orders, and keep operations running smoothly.

🧠 Mixed Reality Passthrough Experience
Play using MR passthrough and see your café blend seamlessly into your real environment for a unique and comfortable VR experience.

👥 Serve Customers & Complete Orders
Handle incoming customers, prepare food and drinks, and deliver orders efficiently to keep everyone happy.

🕹️ Easy & Intuitive Controls
Designed for Meta Quest, the game is accessible for both casual and experienced VR players.

😌 Relaxing Yet Engaging Simulation
Perfect for fans of management games, simulation experiences, and cozy VR gameplay.

Whether you’re new to VR or a simulation enthusiast, Cafe Simulator VR offers a fresh take on café management with top-down gameplay and Mixed Reality immersion.

👉 Build, manage, and enjoy your café—right in your own room!
